learning_objectives.en: Use quantifiers correctly, understand corrections and perform note completion under exam timing.
learning_objectives.vi: Dùng từ chỉ lượng đúng, hiểu sửa thông tin và hoàn thành ghi chú có giới hạn thời gian.

content.en: Many/few are for countable plurals; much/little are for uncountable nouns; some, more, a lot of may work with both. Fewer and less depend on what is counted.
content.vi: Many/few đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều; much/little với không đếm được; some, more, a lot of dùng cả hai. Fewer và less khác theo loại danh từ.

vocabulary.example_en: A small number of volunteers arrived late.
vocabulary.example_vi: Một số ít tình nguyện viên đến muộn.

vocabulary.example_en: A large amount of plastic reached the coast.
vocabulary.example_vi: Lượng lớn nhựa dạt vào bờ.
Ngược lại, sản lượng điện mặt trời tăng.

vocabulary.example_en: To sum up, wetlands provide several services.
vocabulary.example_vi: Tóm lại, đất ngập nước có nhiều vai trò.

grammar.title: Quantifiers
grammar.form: many/few + plural noun; much/little + uncountable noun; more + both

explanation.en: Choose according to the meaning and noun type, not the sound alone.
explanation.vi: Chọn theo nghĩa và loại danh từ, không chỉ theo phát âm.

grammar.example: fewer plastic bottles; less plastic waste; many species; much water

strategies.en: First, secondly and finally structure steps; by contrast indicates opposition; to sum up introduces a conclusion.
strategies.vi: First/secondly/finally sắp xếp; by contrast đối lập; to sum up kết luận.

mini_review.en: Can I distinguish many species from much water?
mini_review.vi: Tôi phân biệt many species với much water chưa?

audios.title: Volunteering for a beach clean-up
audios.transcript:
Organiser: Coastal Care, Jenny speaking.
Caller: Hi, I’d like to volunteer for the beach clean-up this month.
Organiser: Wonderful. We have two dates: Saturday the eighth and Saturday the twenty-second. Which would you prefer?
Caller: The eighth, please.
Organiser: Actually, I’m sorry – the eighth is now full. Could you do the twenty-second?
Caller: Yes, that’s fine.
Organiser: Great. Can I take your name?
Caller: Tariq Hassan. That’s H-A-S-S-A-N.
Organiser: And a phone number?
Caller: Zero seven eight two two, five six one, four four nine.
Organiser: Thanks. We meet at nine in the car park next to the lifeboat station, and we finish at around one.
Caller: What should I bring?
Organiser: We provide gloves and bags, but please bring a reusable water bottle and wear strong shoes – there’s a lot of broken glass on some parts of the beach. If it’s sunny, a hat is a good idea.
Caller: Is there a minimum age? I might bring my daughter.
Organiser: Children over eight are welcome if they’re with an adult. How old is she?
Caller: She’s ten.
Organiser: That’s fine. Finally, at the end of the morning, we record everything we’ve found. The information goes to a national survey of beach rubbish, so it’s really useful.
Caller: Great. See you on the twenty-second.

instruction.en: Fill the correct quantifier based on the noun.
instruction.vi: Điền từ chỉ lượng theo danh từ.

questions.prompt_vi: Chương trình dùng quá ______ nước mùa hè.

questions.prompt_vi: Quan sát thấy ______ tổ hơn năm trước.

questions.prompt_en: The team generated ______ waste after changing suppliers. (fewer/less)
questions.prompt_vi: Nhóm tạo ______ rác hơn sau đổi nhà cung cấp.

questions.prompt_en: A ______ volunteers joined the second clean-up. (few/little)

questions.prompt_en: Only a ______ information was available at the start. (few/little)
